intent.user_request: 用商品图里的甲片制作一条15秒前后反差广告，由同一位新生成的成年女性模特贯穿全片并亲自展示。参考视频只提供展示动作和节奏：开场用中近景看见模特的脸、肩部、完整手臂和裸手，转换后仍保持她与手部同时入画，再展示她佩戴这套甲片的效果。模特是持续的画面主体，甲片是她身上的商业视觉焦点；最后可以靠近展示细节，但仍保留手臂、肩部和虚化的脸部作为清楚的人物关系。
intent.resolved_request: Produce a 15-second before/after contrast advertisement for the nail set in the product image. One newly generated adult female model appears throughout the entire video and personally demonstrates the product. The reference video contributes display actions and pacing only: the video opens in a medium close-up showing the model's face, shoulders, full arms, and bare hands; after the transition, she and her hands stay in frame together while showing the nail set worn. The model remains the sustained visual subject, and the nail set is the commercial focal point on her body. The ending may move closer for nail detail but must keep arms, shoulders, and a blurred face visible to preserve the person relationship.

assets.summary: A person showcases their nails before and after getting a manicure, transitioning from a plain look to a colorful, artistic design, across multiple outdoor scenes.

evidence.description: person_1 stands indoors, wearing outfit_1 (black textured shirt, black belt), showing bare hands with rings. Text overlay: 'POV: 当你第一次做美甲...' (POV: When you get your first manicure...). Hands are raised and moved toward the camera to display nails.

Scene cuts to outdoors. person_1 now wears outfit_2 (light gray off-shoulder top, white pants). Hands are raised, showing new manicure with blue, white, and black nail art. Text overlay: '做了个✨新潮痛甲!' (Got a ✨ trendy pain nail!).
person_1 continues posing outdoors, showing manicured hands from various angles. One hand touches the neck, displaying rings and nails. Background: grassy field, blue sky, distant lake and mountains.

Close-up of hand holding a yellow flower. Nails with blue, white, and black designs are visible. Text overlay: '和蓝天白云草地好搭!' (Matches perfectly with blue sky, white clouds, and grass!). A small inset image shows another hand with similar nail art.
Scene changes. person_1 now wears outfit_3 (beige jacket with brown buttons, white pants, straw hat). Poses with hands raised, showing manicure. Background: grassy hill with a metal tower structure.
person_1 adjusts hat with manicured hands, smiling. Close-up on hands and face. Rings and nail art are prominent.

Final scene. person_1 wears outfit_4 (white off-shoulder top, white pants). Lying on grass, one hand rests on the ground, showing nails. Background: blue sky with clouds, distant mountains. Text overlay not present.
